name: Beryllium sulfate
notes: Extreme LLNA sensitizer; inorganic salt, included as an official validation reference chemical

name: 5-Chloro-2-methyl-4-isothiazolin-3-one (CMIT)
notes: Extreme LLNA sensitizer; tested as the active ingredient of the 1.2% Kathon CG commercial mixture, not the mixture itself

name: 1,4-Benzoquinone
notes: Extreme LLNA sensitizer

name: 4-Phenylenediamine (PPD)
notes: Strong LLNA sensitizer; well-documented hair-dye allergen; LLNA performance-standard reference chemical

name: Chlorpromazine
notes: Strong LLNA sensitizer; tested as the HCl salt (CAS 69-09-0); SMILES shown is the free base

name: Chloramine T
notes: Strong LLNA sensitizer

name: Formaldehyde
notes: Strong LLNA sensitizer; also positive in human and guinea-pig data

name: 2-Mercaptobenzothiazole (MBT)
notes: Moderate LLNA sensitizer; rubber vulcanization accelerant; also positive in human and guinea-pig data

name: Benzyl salicylate
notes: Moderate LLNA sensitizer; fragrance ingredient

name: 1-Thioglycerol
notes: Moderate LLNA sensitizer; structurally similar to glycerol (non-sensitizer) - useful contrast pair

name: Dihydroeugenol
notes: Moderate LLNA sensitizer; saturated analog of eugenol

name: Nickel chloride
notes: LLNA false negative (LLNA performance-standard reference chemical); human and guinea-pig positive; assigned moderate potency by expert judgment despite negative LLNA

name: Benzyl cinnamate
notes: Weak LLNA sensitizer; fragrance ingredient

name: Imidazolidinyl urea
notes: Weak LLNA sensitizer; cosmetic preservative and formaldehyde releaser

name: R-Limonene
notes: Weak LLNA sensitizer; SMILES given without stereochemistry (tested as the R-(+) enantiomer)

name: Methyl methacrylate
notes: Weak LLNA sensitizer; acrylic monomer

name: Glycerol
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer; structurally similar to 1-thioglycerol (sensitizer) - useful contrast pair

name: 2,4-Dichloronitrobenzene (DCNB)
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer; structurally similar to the strong sensitizer DNCB - useful contrast pair

name: Benzyl alcohol
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer

name: Methyl salicylate
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer; LLNA performance-standard reference chemical

name: Isopropanol
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer; common negative control solvent

name: Dimethyl isophthalate
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer

name: 4-Aminobenzoic acid (PABA)
notes: LLNA non-sensitizer

name: Xylene (mixed isomers)
notes: LLNA false positive (EC3 95.8%, LLNA performance-standard reference chemical); human data negative, so 'sensitizer' here reflects the consensus/human status, not the raw LLNA readout. SMILES shown is m-xylene as a representative isomer of the technical mixture actually tested.
